Record the algebraic combiner and native proof simplifications

Document all six checked source commits, removing 81 net lines after charging the three-line formal-identity increase. Record exact compiler/client/check scopes, independent complete-source reviews, 65 preserved public headers and kernel equality of the complete pairing records and programs. Update adoption and the reviewed cumulative reduction to 3097 lines.

Distinguish removal of a direct complex import from transitive availability, retain the unused positivity-premise warning explicitly, and exclude the pre-refresh cached audit from final evidence. Equation source and PDF stay byte-identical.

Bind the constructed rank to exact binary population and a strict growth bound

Use the same native packing, literal adjusted masks and once-shifted source high port to identify an ordinary natural four-block rank. Derive its exact population from both masks, and prove rank at least q cubed and greater than twice the binary window without Pell assumptions.

Record final sequential capped main/check replay and independent isolated review with eight standard-only audits and byte-identical objects. Keep rank congruence, forced temporal exponentiation, and remaining positive source/Pell witnesses explicitly separate.

Establish selective degree bounds before coefficient vanishing

Bound the combined kernel with standard degree-of-sum and monomial bounds. Establish the row product degree once from its encoding and complementary kernel, then derive coefficient vanishing from that degree bound. Reorder the two existing public lemmas to share this argument, keeping their complete statement set and every polynomial definition unchanged. Remove eighteen lines including the BigOperators import, with no helper overhead.

Validation: fresh module, native position/coefficient clients, existing selective packing and position checks, and public axiom comparison pass within the twelve-call rotation/support batch. All twenty-two old reports are byte-identical. Independent full-source/degree-contract review confirms zero polynomials, empty row families, cancellations, unused collisions and natural truncated complementary exponents require no stronger assumptions.

Derive cyclic rotation from convolution with a single impulse

Specialize word_convolution to Pi.single t 1 and simplify the resulting word and convolution. Remove seventeen lines of repeated reindexing and modular-power arithmetic. All rotation, carry and partial-phase definitions and original assumptions remain unchanged, including radix one and length one cases.

Validation with the accompanying degree refactor: both fresh modules, four direct clients and one planned uncached NativeCyclicCarry prerequisite, four existing focused checks and the final twenty-two-result public axiom comparison pass. Independent complete-source/convolution/edge-case review passes. Native Boolean phase and non-Boolean carry controls are retained.

Derive exact mask populations and preserve the same packing across whole periods

Prove ordinary lower-block strictness from binary disjointness before calculating the exact four-block population, with no Pell lower-bound assumption. Transfer the same source, carries and F across congruent strides using actual rotation equality and a newly derived transport congruence.

Record root and independent isolated replays, twelve standard-only axiom audits, matching objects, overlap and noncongruent-rotation controls. Keep actual rank calibration, forced-stride selection and remaining positive Pell witnesses explicit.

Reuse pair-existence lemmas in shared-register projection proofs

Replace the two repeated inverse-pairing certificate arguments with the already imported left/right projection equivalences. Expand finite witnesses in the same order, retaining the missing pair component and inequality slack in their original slots. Remove twelve lines without a new helper or import.

Validation: fresh module, existing RegisterRelations client/focus, old-public audit and whole-old-source equality audit pass first try. All thirteen public axiom reports match baseline. The kernel accepts rfl for the complete old/new relation records, graph records and all-parameter programs. Independent full-source/certificate/witness-order review passes.

Reuse the divisibility criterion for an odd auxiliary Pell index

Apply SignedPellResidue.odd_index_of_base_dvd to the actual classified first root and delete the unused positive-index derivation. Preserve every original hypothesis, Qh identity, sign alternative and signed quotient case. Remove twenty source lines including the added import.

Validation: ten final prerequisite/module/client/check/audit calls pass after compiling the missing unchanged SignedPellResidue object. The initial target invocation stopped before elaboration; an old-cache audit is excluded from final evidence. All seven refreshed public axiom reports match baseline. The retained hy premise now has an unused-variable warning because its dead intermediate was removed. Independent complete-source/shared-oddness review passes.

Reuse the ordinary Pell lower estimate for the doubled native ratio

Specialize the existing lower-key and undoubled lower-ratio theorems, then multiply the strict natural inequality by positive two. Retain the literal doubled k coordinate, factor two, all nine public theorem signatures and every premise. Remove seventeen lines including the added lower HTP import.

Validation: the target, three direct native clients, four existing focused checks and final nine-theorem axiom audit pass first try. Baseline/final reports are byte-identical; only an existing unused-hd client warning remains. Independent full-source and ratio-contract review passes.

Prove the two-radicand combiner identity in the polynomial ring

Use injectivity of exponent dilation to establish the exact formal core identity before evaluation. Replace the chosen complex square roots and integer-to-complex cast argument with that identity, retaining all existing polynomial data and public statements. Remove the direct complex-polynomial import; transitive Complex availability remains. The complete source grows from 83 to 86 lines, trading three lines for simpler mathematical prerequisites and a reusable formal theorem.

Validation: the target, three Jones/equation clients, existing 63-endpoint CompilerAxioms check, old-public comparison and new-core audit pass first try. Both old axiom reports are byte-identical and the new theorem uses standard axioms. Independent full-source and expand/evaluation-contract review passes; no dependency adjustment or proof repair.

Place controller bits safely and discharge the ordinary nonwrapping bound

Embed the actual power positions and optional cell three with exact finite cardinality and canonical no-wrap values. Bound every literal kernel term and the full coefficient mass, then use the existing high-prefix bound for the same F to prove the required ordinary increment fits below q minus one.

Construct the updated carry solution with both ordinary C/F equalities and the resulting exact rank decrement. Document independent full-source isolated replays, twenty-six standard-only audits and matching objects. Finite-support accumulation and final rank calibration remain separate.
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main'

Place thirteen more DiophantineConsistency Lean simplification packets

Thirteen drop-zone archives of 26 October (drop commits 89226e3921,
89f3a32b33, 5b24be5bc0 and eab031e8ba) are placed in arrival order. They
go under research/lean-proof-simplification/ as 2026-10-26x, y, z and
2026-10-26za through zj; the z-prefix keeps the letters sorted after w.
Each PLACEMENT.md names the latest commit its README pins, from
1e2a853935 to efa64ca941.

The placement omits 2,350 of the 3,302 members, mostly bundled source
snapshots. Each omitted member is byte-identical to a Git blob of the
packet's reviewed commit, of 60e9c5d620 or of the placement parent.
OMITTED.tsv lists each with its blob hash and a repository path holding
the same bytes.

The directory index and the docs/incoming README table now list
thirty-six packets, and the thirteen ZIPs are retired. Adoption is left
to the research session. No supplied script or Lean file was run.
